Henning Glerup is a medical professional specializing in gastroenterology, serving as a consultant physician with special responsibility (*specialeansvarlig overlæge*) representing the Central Denmark Region (*Region Midtjylland*) [^src1]. He is a member of the steering group for the [[dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme|Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme]] (DANIBD) [^src1]. 

In this capacity, Glerup contributes to the strategic management of Denmark's national efforts to systematize and improve the treatment of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) [^src1]. The steering group acts as the central strategic unit overseeing cross-regional quality measurement, standardized coding, and the evidence-based development of treatment guidelines [^src1]. His inclusion in the 2023 annual report—which details quality data and clinical benchmarking from October 1, 2022, to September 30, 2023—underscores his specialized competence and leadership responsibilities in evaluating treatment access and implementing quality indicators across Danish healthcare regions [^src1].
